name: Rain Archive long memory benchmark
description: A deterministic long-history dataset for checking whether AIDM retrieves relevant campaign facts after many unrelated events.

events.text: Mara the archivist hid the silver ledger beneath the third stair of the west archive before the storm.
The party met Captain Orin, who warned them that the Brass Choir uses coded hymns to mark targets.
Lio promised a street child named Fen that he would return the blue glass marble after the investigation.
A locked reliquary was sealed with a moon-shaped sigil and resisted ordinary lockpicks.
The old apothecary sold Mira a vial of ashroot antidote that cures one poison condition.
The party found muddy bootprints leading from the archive roof toward Bellmaker Alley.
A masked duelist spared the party because they carried the signet of House Vale.
The ghost of Sister Elian can only speak when a candle is lit with saltwater flame.
The sealed ledger lists payments from Magistrate Cale to the Brass Choir.
A rival investigator named Juno stole a page describing a hidden lift under the west archive stairs.
The party rested at the Copper Kettle and heard rumors about wolves outside the city.
Orin's badge was found in a rain barrel, but there was no blood on it.
Fen said the blue marble originally belonged to his missing sister Iva.
Mara fears bells because the Brass Choir conditioned her with a punishment hymn.
The moon-shaped sigil reacts to silver dust and opens for exactly one minute.
The party bought rope, chalk, and a collapsible lantern from the night market.
A crow familiar followed the party after they entered Bellmaker Alley.
Magistrate Cale plans to burn the archive at dawn to erase payment records.
Juno is not loyal to Cale; she wants leverage to free her brother from debtor prison.
The hidden lift under the west archive stairs descends to a cistern shrine.
The cistern shrine contains a cracked bronze bell that amplifies spoken oaths.
Mira used the ashroot antidote on Orin after he was poisoned by black needle tea.
The party learned that black needle tea is imported through Dock Seven.
House Vale's signet grants safe passage through the old courthouse tunnels.
Iva was last seen carrying a red umbrella near Dock Seven.
The Brass Choir stores coded hymns in a pipe organ below the old courthouse.
A broken organ key bears the same moon-shaped sigil as the archive reliquary.
The party promised Juno they would help free her brother if she returned the stolen page.
Cale's private guard wears green lacquered masks and carries hooked sabers.
The west archive stair creaks loudly unless weight is placed on the outer edge.

queries.query: Where did Mara hide the silver ledger?
How can we open the moon sigil reliquary?
What promise did we make to Fen about the marble?
Why might Juno help us against Magistrate Cale?
What do we know about the Brass Choir hymns?
